[P1] Build and transfer the OTel workspace before loading examples

On a clean runner, `generate-examples` imports `otel-runtime-carrier.ts`, which imports `@aws/durable-execution-sdk-js-otel`. These steps only build core, testing, and extras; `npm ci` links OTel to its unbuilt workspace, whose exports reference generated `dist*` files. Catalog generation therefore fails with a module-resolution error, and the dependent cloud job never runs. Build OTel before generation and include its outputs in `lmi-fixture` (or rebuild it in the cloud job), since the selected Jest suite also imports OTel.
